title: crosswalk
description: The persistent mapping from contributor key to donor id, as of the snapshot's build, which keeps donor ids stable from build to build. One file, `crosswalk.parquet`.

contributor_key.description: The contributor key, the `contributor` table's key.

donor_id.description: The donor it is resolved to.

assigned_at.description: When the key was last given its donor id.

build_id.description: The build that last gave it, `YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ` of the run's start.
